runs.text: Fine-tuned model designed to estimate the quality of multilingual samples across 18 languages.
Trained on a pairwise dataset of ~2.3K expert-revised (positive) and original (negative) samples per language.
Negative responses typically suffer from content errors, machine translation artifacts, and insufficient cultural localization.
Positive responses demonstrate deeper reasoning, higher complexity, and greater comprehensiveness.
Optimized using a triplet loss function in the embedding space to learn relative quality evaluation.
